- BrightHealth: RDW-3421 — currently Stage: Negotiation, Close date: 2028-05-31 (entered 2028-02), ACV variance flagged. Owner: @Lauren
- BrightHealth: RDW-3490 — Stage: Contract, Close date: 2028-06-15 (no PO on file). Owner: @Aditya
- BrightHealth: RDW-3555 — Stage: Proposal, Close date: 2028-05-20 (stale activity >30d). Owner: @Vivek

Thanks — trying to keep the forecast clean for Friday's finance sync.
